role: Sharpen engine juror (senior X ghostwriter and copy chief)
score_note: 'score' (the app's Claude path) is carried over from set 5; the Claude path is unchanged in v4.4.
verdict: On a sixth blind set of ordinary drafts, the v4.4 on-device engine scored 95.0% postable (91.8% on lines that need work). It left 47/47 sharp lines and every deadpan label alone, kept 'like a year' and 'like 9 times', changed no fact or meaning, and fixed all five set-5 problems; sharpen.js gives the same output as core.js. One typo-level break remains, and the homepage shows it: the contraction tidy writes 'googling it’s a skill' (v-82), adding a curly apostrophe the writer never used. That, a few unchanged run-ups and long run-ons, and one awkward put-back keep it just under 9.5.
to_95_ondevice: Contraction tidy: contract 'it/that/I/we is/am/are' only when the pronoun opens its clause (sentence start or after and/but/so/because) and the next token is not a preposition or the end. Never contract across a cut. Use the writer's own apostrophe (straight or curly). Fixes v-82 and the curly apostrophe in w-58.

Put-back onto a reshaped line: when the writer puts back an opener that the reshape moved away from ('So' before a result-first line), go back to the light edit in the writer's order instead of prefixing the reshaped line (v-46: 'So my open rate basically doubled. What changed: …').

Don't cut 'really' when it modifies the line's main verb ('before anything really moves', v-0). Keep a soft hedge when cutting the other one would leave a bare verb opener ('Kind of think' -> 'Think …', v-87).
Coverage: 'one of the biggest lessons I've learned … is to' (v-28) and 'In this week's issue I wrote about why I think' (v-42). On a >280 run-on, offer the split (v-114).

issues.area: On-device engine / homepage demo / app instant line
issues.where: core.js contraction tidy (CONTRACT_W) after a cut; default and strict
issues.problem: v-82 'Reading the whole error message before googling it is honestly a skill…' becomes '…before googling it’s a skill that took me years to learn.' The verb of a gerund subject gets contracted onto the gerund's object, which is ungrammatical, and the curly apostrophe doesn't match the writer's straight ones. The homepage shows it under 'What changed' with 'Without “honestly”, the claim stands on its own.' It is the only break in a pattern scan of all 720 lines from sets 1-6.
issues.fix: Gate the tidy: contract only a pronoun that opens its clause, never when the pronoun follows a verb or preposition (it is then an object), never across a cut boundary, and use the draft's apostrophe. Add 'gerund + object pronoun + 's' as a strict reject and a gWhole check.

issues.where: sharpenLine with keep on a result-first reshape
issues.problem: v-46: the result-first line 'My open rate basically doubled. What changed: I finally cleaned my list…' gets 'So' put back as 'So my open rate basically doubled. What changed: …', which reads oddly; the writer's 'So' introduced the story, not the result.
issues.fix: When a kept word sat before a span the reshape moved, switch to the version that keeps the writer's order (the split alt here).

issues.where: intens cut on a key verb; double-softener cut
issues.problem: v-0 'before anything really moves' -> 'before anything moves' gives a stronger claim. v-87 'Kind of think most side projects…' loses both 'Kind of' and 'tbh', leaving a bare 'Think …' opener that reads like an order.
issues.fix: Keep 'really' right before the main verb of a clause. When cutting would leave a sentence starting with a bare verb of thinking, keep the softener in front of it.

issues.problem: A few everyday run-ups stay: 'I think one of the biggest lessons I've learned as a founder this year is to …' (v-28) and 'In this week's issue I wrote about why I think …' (v-42). A 340-char run-on (v-114) gets two words cut and no split.
issues.fix: 'one of the biggest lessons I've learned (as X)( this year) is to' -> 'Lesson:' or a colon. 'In this week's issue I wrote about why' -> 'This week's issue: why'. On a >280 line, split at ', and today' / ', so if'.

issues.problem: The Claude-path score (9.6) carries over from set 5, which a stand-in graded at default effort. Production runs Opus 5.5 at low effort with a 12 s timeout.
issues.fix: Before launch, re-run sets 1-6 (720 lines) through sharpenClaude at production settings and report postable %, timeout, cap and rules rates.
